title: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction

blocks.tex:
This chapter supplies the zero used to balance the auxiliary tangential
polygon. Four chosen coefficients alternate in sign. All other coefficients,
including zeros, remain present. First collapse their vertices onto a square
and its side contacts; then move to a strictly ordered finite fan. The
perturbation changes the geometry, not the prescribed coefficients.

blocks.label: st:field-halfplanes
blocks.title: Winding comparison in open half-planes
blocks.body:
Let $\gamma,\eta:[0,1]\to\mathbb C\setminus\{0\}$ be continuous closed loops.
Suppose that for every $t$ there is a real linear functional $L_t$ with
$L_t(\gamma(t))>0$ and $L_t(\eta(t))>0$. Then their winding numbers about zero
are equal. No continuity of the choice $L_t$ is required. For a continuous
real phase $\phi$, the nonvanishing path $e^{i\phi(t)}$ has winding
$(\phi(1)-\phi(0))/(2\pi)$.

lean.name: Complex.phaseCurve_ne_zero

theorem phaseCurve_ne_zero (φ : C(I, ℝ)) (t : I) : phaseCurve φ t ≠ 0 :=

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_phaseCurve
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_phaseCurve (φ : C(I, ℝ)) :
    windingNumberAt 0 (phaseCurve φ) (phaseCurve_ne_zero φ) =
      (φ 1 - φ 0) / (2 * Real.pi) := by
  apply windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift _ φ
  simp [phaseCurve, norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane (γ η : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) (hη : ∀ t, η t ≠ 0)
    (hγloop : γ 0 = γ 1) (hηloop : η 0 = η 1)
    (hcone : ∀ t, ∃ L : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, 0 < L (γ t) ∧ 0 < L (η t)) :
    windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ = windingNumberAt 0 η hη := by
  let H : C(I × I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ (1 - (st.1 : ℝ)) • γ st.2 + (st.1 : ℝ) • η st.2, by fun_prop⟩
  refine windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy 0 γ η hγ hη H ?_
    (by simp [H]) (by simp [H]) (by simp [H, hγloop, hηloop])
  intro st hzero
  obtain ⟨L, hLγ, hLη⟩ := hcone st.2
  have hpos : 0 < L (H st) :=
    (convex_halfSpace_gt L.isLinear 0) hLγ hLη
      (sub_nonneg.mpr st.1.property.2) st.1.property.1 (sub_add_cancel _ _)
  simp [hzero] at hpos

The straight homotopy $(1-s)\gamma(t)+s\eta(t)$ remains in the positive
half-plane of $L_t$, so never vanishes. The two input loops make it a homotopy
through closed loops; winding is invariant under this homotopy. The phase
formula follows by using $\phi$ itself as the continuous argument lift.

blocks.label: st:field-convex-zero
blocks.title: A winding obstruction on a convex set
blocks.body:
Let $S\subseteq\mathbb C$ be convex and contain a point $a$. Let $F$ be
continuous on $S$, and let $\gamma$ be a continuous closed loop in $S$ such
that $F\circ\gamma$ never vanishes and has nonzero winding about zero.
Then $F$ vanishes at some point of $S$. The loop need not be a circular
parametrization of the boundary of $S$.

lean.name: Complex.exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex
lean.code:
theorem exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex
    {S : Set ℂ} (hS : Convex ℝ S) (a : ℂ) (ha : a ∈ S)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (hF : ContinuousOn F S) (γ : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ S) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1) (havoid : ∀ t, F (γ t) ≠ 0)
    (hw : windingNumberAt 0 ⟨F ∘ γ, hF.comp_continuous γ.continuous hγ⟩ havoid ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ S, F x = 0 := by
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  let A : C(I × I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ (1 - (st.1 : ℝ)) • γ st.2 + (st.1 : ℝ) • a, by fun_prop⟩
  have hA : ∀ st, A st ∈ S := fun st ↦
    hS (hγ st.2) ha (sub_nonneg.mpr st.1.property.2) st.1.property.1
      (sub_add_cancel _ _)
  let H : C(I × I, ℂ) := ⟨F ∘ A, hF.comp_continuous A.continuous hA⟩
  have heq := windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy 0
    ⟨F ∘ γ, hF.comp_continuous γ.continuous hγ⟩ (ContinuousMap.const I (F a))
    havoid (fun _ ↦ hnone a ha) H (fun st ↦ hnone _ (hA st))
    (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def]) (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def])
    (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def, hloop])
  exact hw (heq.trans (windingNumberAt_const 0 (F a) (fun _ ↦ hnone a ha)))

If $F$ had no zero in $S$, applying $F$ to
$(1-s)\gamma(t)+sa$ would give a nonvanishing homotopy from $F\circ\gamma$
to the constant loop at $F(a)$. Its winding would therefore be zero, a
contradiction. Convexity keeps the entire homotopy in $S$.

blocks.label: st:field-diamond
blocks.title: The diamond and its boundary loop
blocks.body:
For $r\in\mathbb R$, set
\[
 D_r=\{x+iy:|x|+|y|\le r\}.
\]
This set is convex and compact. For $r\ge0$ a closed continuous boundary
loop is
\[
 b_r(t)=\frac{r\,e^{2\pi it}}
 {|\cos(2\pi t)|+|\sin(2\pi t)|},\qquad 0\le t\le1.
\]
It satisfies $|\operatorname{Re}b_r(t)|+|\operatorname{Im}b_r(t)|=r$.

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary_mem
lean.code:
theorem diamondBoundary_mem {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (t : I) :
    |(diamondBoundary r t).re| + |(diamondBoundary r t).im| = r := by
  simp only [diamondBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, smul_re, smul_im, smul_eq_mul,
    abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hr (l1_unitLoop_pos t).le)]
  rw [← mul_add, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (l1_unitLoop_pos t).ne']

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary_closed

theorem diamondBoundary_closed (r : ℝ) : diamondBoundary r 0 = diamondBoundary r 1 := by

lean.name: Complex.isCompact_diamond

theorem isCompact_diamond (r : ℝ) : IsCompact (diamond r) := by
  apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r).of_isClosed_subset
    (isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  intro z hz
  simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
    (norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im z).trans hz

lean.name: Complex.convex_diamond
lean.code:
theorem convex_diamond (r : ℝ) : Convex ℝ (diamond r) := by
  have hre : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℂ ↦ |z.re|) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (convexOn_norm (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ))).comp_linearMap Complex.reLm
  have him : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℂ ↦ |z.im|) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (convexOn_norm (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ))).comp_linearMap Complex.imLm
  simpa [diamond] using (hre.add him).convex_le r

lean.code: def diamond (r : ℝ) : Set ℂ := {z | |z.re| + |z.im| ≤ r}

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary
lean.code:
noncomputable def diamondBoundary (r : ℝ) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ (r / (|(unitLoop t).re| + |(unitLoop t).im|)) • unitLoop t, by
    exact (continuous_const.div ((Complex.continuous_re.comp unitLoop.continuous).abs.add
      (Complex.continuous_im.comp unitLoop.continuous).abs)
      (fun t ↦ (l1_unitLoop_pos t).ne')).smul unitLoop.continuous⟩

blocks.tex:
The sum of the two absolute coordinate functions is convex, so its sublevel
sets are convex. The diamond is closed and contained in the Euclidean closed
ball of radius $r$; the empty case causes no difficulty. The displayed
boundary denominator is positive because a unit vector has positive
coordinate one-norm. Its normalization gives the boundary identity, and the
periodicity of the unit circle gives $b_r(0)=b_r(1)$.

blocks.label: st:field-diamond-zero
blocks.title: Four signs force a zero in the diamond
blocks.body:
Let $r>0$ and $F$ be continuous on $D_r$. On $|x|+|y|=r$, assume
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
 y\ge|x| & \operatorname{Re}F(x+iy)>0\\
 -x\ge|y| & \operatorname{Im}F(x+iy)<0\\
 -y\ge|x| & \operatorname{Re}F(x+iy)<0\\
 x\ge|y| & \operatorname{Im}F(x+iy)>0.
\end{array}
\]
Then $F$ has a zero in $D_r$.

lean.name: Complex.DiamondSigns
lean.code:
structure DiamondSigns (F : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) : Prop where
  top : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.re| ≤ z.im → 0 < (F z).re
  left : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.im| ≤ -z.re → (F z).im < 0
  bottom : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.re| ≤ -z.im → (F z).re < 0
  right : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.im| ≤ z.re → 0 < (F z).im

lean.name: Complex.exists_zero_of_diamondSigns
lean.code:
theorem exists_zero_of_diamondSigns {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (diamond r)) (hsigns : DiamondSigns F r) :
    ∃ z ∈ diamond r, F z = 0 := by
  have hmem : ∀ t, diamondBoundary r t ∈ diamond r :=
    fun t ↦ (diamondBoundary_mem hr.le t).le
  let γ : C(I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨F ∘ diamondBoundary r, hF.comp_continuous (diamondBoundary r).continuous hmem⟩
  have hcone : ∀ t, ∃ L : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, 0 < L (γ t) ∧
      0 < L (phaseCurve reversedPhase t) := diamondSigns_boundaryCone hr hsigns
  have hne : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨L, hL, -⟩ := hcone t
    simp [ht] at hL
  have hmodel : phaseCurve reversedPhase 0 = phaseCurve reversedPhase 1 := by
    rw [reversedPhase_eq_swap, reversedPhase_eq_swap, unitLoop_closed]
  have hw := windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane γ (phaseCurve reversedPhase)
    hne (phaseCurve_ne_zero reversedPhase) (congrArg F (diamondBoundary_closed r))
    hmodel hcone
  refine exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex (convex_diamond r) 0
    (by simpa [diamond] using hr.le) F hF (diamondBoundary r) hmem
    (diamondBoundary_closed r) hne ?_
  exact (hw.trans reversedPhase_winding).trans_ne (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)

blocks.tex:
Compare $F(b_r(t))$ with
$v(t)=e^{i(\pi/2-2\pi t)}=i\overline{e^{2\pi it}}$.
At each boundary point, select one of the four coordinate-dominant arcs in
the table. The indicated signed coordinate functional is strictly positive
on both $F(b_r(t))$ and $v(t)$. This also proves boundary nonvanishing,
including arc endpoints where two conditions may apply. The half-plane
comparison gives winding $-1$, the winding of $v$. Apply the convex-set
zero lemma to $D_r$. This orientation calculation concerns the reflected
field loop; the domain boundary itself is parametrized counterclockwise.

blocks.label: st:field-sign-stability
blocks.title: Uniform persistence of the four signs
blocks.body:
Let $F(a,z)$ be jointly continuous at every $(a_0,z)$ with $z\in D_r$.
If $F(a_0,\cdot)$ has the four strict signs above, then all sufficiently
nearby parameters $a$ have these same signs on the entire boundary.
More generally, if $g$ is continuous, the boundary slice
\[
 \{z:|\operatorname{Re}z|+|\operatorname{Im}z|=r,\ g(z)\ge0\}
\]
is compact, and strict positivity of a continuous linear functional of
$F(a_0,z)$ on this slice persists uniformly for nearby $a$.

lean.name: Complex.eventually_diamondSigns
lean.code:
theorem eventually_diamondSigns {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    {F : A → ℂ → ℂ} {a : A} {r : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ z ∈ diamond r, ContinuousAt (fun p : A × ℂ ↦ F p.1 p.2) (a, z))
    (hs : DiamondSigns (F a) r) :
    ∀ᶠ b in 𝓝 a, DiamondSigns (F b) r := by
  have ht := eventually_pos_on_diamondFace hF reCLM
    (g := fun z ↦ z.im - |z.re|) (by fun_prop)
    (fun z hz ↦ hs.top z hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mp hz.2))
  have hl := eventually_pos_on_diamondFace hF (-imCLM)
    (g := fun z ↦ -z.re - |z.im|) (by fun_prop)
    (fun z hz ↦ neg_pos.mpr (hs.left z hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mp hz.2)))
  have hb := eventually_pos_on_diamondFace hF (-reCLM)
    (g := fun z ↦ -z.im - |z.re|) (by fun_prop)
    (fun z hz ↦ neg_pos.mpr (hs.bottom z hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mp hz.2)))
  have hr := eventually_pos_on_diamondFace hF imCLM
    (g := fun z ↦ z.re - |z.im|) (by fun_prop)
    (fun z hz ↦ hs.right z hz.1 (sub_nonneg.mp hz.2))
  filter_upwards [ht, hl, hb, hr] with b ht hl hb hr
  exact ⟨fun z he hz ↦ ht z ⟨he, sub_nonneg.mpr hz⟩,
    fun z he hz ↦ neg_pos.mp (hl z ⟨he, sub_nonneg.mpr hz⟩),
    fun z he hz ↦ neg_pos.mp (hb z ⟨he, sub_nonneg.mpr hz⟩),
    fun z he hz ↦ hr z ⟨he, sub_nonneg.mpr hz⟩⟩

lean.name: Complex.eventually_pos_on_diamondFace
lean.code:
lemma eventually_pos_on_diamondFace {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    {F : A → ℂ → ℂ} {a : A} {r : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ z ∈ diamond r, ContinuousAt (fun p : A × ℂ ↦ F p.1 p.2) (a, z))
    (L : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g)
    (hsign : ∀ z ∈ diamondFace r g, 0 < L (F a z)) :
    ∀ᶠ b in 𝓝 a, ∀ z ∈ diamondFace r g, 0 < L (F b z) := by
  apply (isCompact_diamondFace r hg).eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro z hz
  exact (L.continuous.continuousAt.comp (hF z hz.1.le))
    (Ioi_mem_nhds (hsign z hz))

blocks.tex:
The slice is closed in the compact diamond. At each of its points joint
continuity preserves a strict scalar inequality on a product neighborhood.
Compactness supplies finitely many such neighborhoods and hence one common
parameter neighborhood. Apply this to the four slices with
$g=y-|x|,-x-|y|,-y-|x|,x-|y|$ and functionals
$\operatorname{Re},-\operatorname{Im},-\operatorname{Re},\operatorname{Im}$.
Intersect the four resulting parameter neighborhoods.

blocks.label: st:field-square
blocks.title: The square limiting field
blocks.body:
Put coefficients $A,-B,C,-D$, with $A,B,C,D>0$, at the counterclockwise
square corners $(1,1),(-1,1),(-1,-1),(1,-1)$. Put arbitrary real coefficients
$T,L,H,R$ at the top, left, bottom, and right side contacts. The finite
rational field $G(z)=\sum_j c_jX_j/(1-\langle z,X_j\rangle)$ has horizontal
component
\[
 U(x,y)=\frac{A}{1-x-y}+\frac{B}{1+x-y}
 -\frac{C}{1+x+y}-\frac{D}{1-x+y}
 -\frac{L}{1+x}+\frac{R}{1-x}.
\]
Its vertical component is the same expression with
$(A,B,C,D,L,R,x,y)$ replaced by $(A,D,C,B,H,T,y,x)$.
The top and bottom side contacts have zero horizontal contribution,
regardless of the size of their coefficients.

blocks.label: st:field-upper-estimate
blocks.title: Uniform upper-arc estimate
blocks.body:
Suppose $\epsilon>0$, $|x|+y=1-\epsilon$, and $|x|\le y$.
Then $1-x-y$ and $1+x-y$ are at least $\epsilon$, with one equal to
$\epsilon$; $1+x+y$ and $1-x+y$ are at least $1$; and $1\pm x\ge1/2$.
For nonnegative $A,B,C,D$ this gives
\[
 U(x,y)\ge\frac{\min(A,B)}{\epsilon}-C-D-2|L|-2|R|.
\]
In particular this component is positive when the right-hand side is positive.
Opposite arcs obey the exact identity
\[
 U_{C,D,A,B,R,L}(-x,-y)=-U_{A,B,C,D,L,R}(x,y).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.abs_div_le_two_mul
lean.code:
theorem abs_div_le_two_mul {u δ : ℝ} (hδ : 1 / 2 ≤ δ) : |u / δ| ≤ 2 * |u| := by
  rw [abs_div]
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg u)
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num) (hδ.trans (le_abs_self δ))
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h

theorem upper_denominators {ε x y : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbd : |x| + y = 1 - ε) (htop : |x| ≤ y) :
    ε ≤ 1 - x - y ∧ ε ≤ 1 + x - y ∧
      1 ≤ 1 + x + y ∧ 1 ≤ 1 - x + y ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ 1 + x ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ 1 - x ∧
      (1 - x - y = ε ∨ 1 + x - y = ε) := by
  rcases le_total 0 x with hx | hx
  all_goals grind [abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos]

    upperProjection c d a b right left (-x) (-y) =
      -upperProjection a b c d left right x y := by
  unfold upperProjection
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.upperProjection_pos

theorem upperProjection_pos {ε a b c d left right x y : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hbd : |x| + y = 1 - ε) (htop : |x| ≤ y)
    (hmargin : c + d + 2 * |left| + 2 * |right| < min a b / ε) :
    0 < upperProjection a b c d left right x y := by
  have h := upperProjection_lower_bound (left := left) (right := right)
    hε ha hb hc hd hbd htop
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.upperProjection_lower_bound
lean.code:
theorem upperProjection_lower_bound {ε a b c d left right x y : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hbd : |x| + y = 1 - ε) (htop : |x| ≤ y) :
    min a b / ε - c - d - 2 * |left| - 2 * |right| ≤
      upperProjection a b c d left right x y := by
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, hleft, hright, hactive⟩ := upper_denominators hε hbd htop
  have hlead : min a b / ε ≤ a / (1 - x - y) + b / (1 + x - y) := by
    rcases hactive with hactive | hactive
    all_goals rw [hactive]
    · exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left a b) hε.le).trans
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg hb (hε.le.trans h₁)))
    · exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right a b) hε.le).trans
        (le_add_of_nonneg_left (div_nonneg ha (hε.le.trans h₀)))
  unfold upperProjection
  linarith only [hlead, div_le_self hc h₂, div_le_self hd h₃,
    abs_div_le_two_mul (u := left) hleft, abs_div_le_two_mul (u := right) hright,
    le_abs_self (left / (1 + x)), neg_abs_le (right / (1 - x))]

blocks.tex:
Separate $x\ge0$ and $x\le0$ in the boundary identity. One of the two upper
corner denominators is exactly the inset $\epsilon$, so its nonnegative
term is at least $\min(A,B)/\epsilon$; the other term is nonnegative.
The lower corner terms are bounded by $C,D$. For any $\delta\ge1/2$,
$|u/\delta|\le2|u|$, which bounds the arbitrary side-contact terms.
Adding the estimates gives the claim, uniformly on the whole arc. The
opposite-arc identity follows by substituting $(-x,-y)$ in the six terms.

blocks.label: st:field-margins
blocks.title: One inset satisfies all four margins
blocks.body:
For $A,B,C,D>0$ and arbitrary $T,L,H,R$, there exists $0<\epsilon<1$ such that
\[
\begin{aligned}
 C+D+2|L|+2|R|&<\min(A,B)/\epsilon,\\
 A+D+2|T|+2|H|&<\min(C,B)/\epsilon,\\
 A+B+2|R|+2|L|&<\min(C,D)/\epsilon,\\
 C+B+2|H|+2|T|&<\min(A,D)/\epsilon.
\end{aligned}
\]
These inequalities imply all four diamond signs for $G$ on $D_{1-\epsilon}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.exists_margins
lean.code:
theorem SquareWeights.exists_margins {w : SquareWeights} (hw : w.Positive) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧ w.Margins ε := by
  let m := min (min w.a w.b) (min w.c w.d)
  let M := w.a + w.b + w.c + w.d +
    2 * |w.top| + 2 * |w.left| + 2 * |w.bottom| + 2 * |w.right| + 1
  have hm : 0 < m := lt_min (lt_min hw.1 hw.2.1) (lt_min hw.2.2.1 hw.2.2.2)
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    dsimp [M]
    linarith [hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2.1, hw.2.2.2, abs_nonneg w.top,
      abs_nonneg w.left, abs_nonneg w.bottom, abs_nonneg w.right]
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsmall⟩ := exists_between (lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hm hM))
  have hbound : M < m / ε := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hε).mpr
    simpa [mul_comm] using (lt_div_iff₀ hM).mp (hsmall.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  refine ⟨ε, hε, hsmall.trans_le (min_le_left _ _), ?_⟩
  constructor <;> refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_
    (lt_of_lt_of_le hbound (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hε.le))
  all_goals grind [SquareWeights.Positive, abs_nonneg]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.Margins
lean.code:
structure SquareWeights.Margins (w : SquareWeights) (ε : ℝ) : Prop where
  top : w.c + w.d + 2 * |w.left| + 2 * |w.right| < min w.a w.b / ε
  left : w.a + w.d + 2 * |w.top| + 2 * |w.bottom| < min w.c w.b / ε
  bottom : w.a + w.b + 2 * |w.right| + 2 * |w.left| < min w.c w.d / ε
  right : w.c + w.b + 2 * |w.bottom| + 2 * |w.top| < min w.a w.d / ε

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.diamondSigns
lean.code:
theorem SquareWeights.diamondSigns {w : SquareWeights} {ε : ℝ}
    (hw : w.Positive) (hε : 0 < ε) (hm : w.Margins ε) :
    Complex.DiamondSigns w.field (1 - ε) := by
  rcases hw with ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩
  constructor
  all_goals intro z hbd hside
  · exact upperProjection_pos hε ha.le hb.le hc.le hd.le
      (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg ((abs_nonneg z.re).trans hside)] using hbd)
      hside hm.top
  · have hp := upperProjection_pos (left := w.top) (right := w.bottom)
      (x := -z.im) (y := -z.re) hε hc.le hb.le ha.le hd.le
      (by simpa [abs_of_nonpos (neg_nonneg.mp ((abs_nonneg z.im).trans hside)),
        add_comm] using hbd)
      (by simpa using hside) hm.left
    exact neg_pos.mp ((upperProjection_opposite
      w.a w.d w.c w.b w.bottom w.top z.im z.re) ▸ hp)
  · have hp := upperProjection_pos (left := w.right) (right := w.left)
      (x := -z.re) (y := -z.im) hε hc.le hd.le ha.le hb.le
      (by simpa [abs_of_nonpos (neg_nonneg.mp ((abs_nonneg z.re).trans hside))]
        using hbd)
      (by simpa using hside) hm.bottom
    exact neg_pos.mp ((upperProjection_opposite
      w.a w.b w.c w.d w.left w.right z.re z.im) ▸ hp)
  · exact upperProjection_pos hε ha.le hd.le hc.le hb.le
      (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg ((abs_nonneg z.im).trans hside), add_comm] using hbd)
      hside hm.right

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.exists_zero
lean.code:
theorem SquareWeights.exists_zero {w : SquareWeights} (hw : w.Positive) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, |z.re| + |z.im| < 1 ∧ w.field z = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε₁, hm⟩ := exists_margins hw
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzero⟩ := Complex.exists_zero_of_diamondSigns (sub_pos.mpr hε₁)
    w.field (w.continuousOn_field hε) (diamondSigns hw hε hm)
  exact ⟨z, lt_of_le_of_lt hz (sub_lt_self 1 hε), hzero⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SquareWeights.continuousOn_field
lean.code:
theorem SquareWeights.continuousOn_field (w : SquareWeights) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ContinuousOn w.field (Complex.diamond (1 - ε)) := by
  apply continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇⟩ := diamond_denominators hε hz
  unfold SquareWeights.field upperProjection
  simp_rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
  fun_prop (disch := linarith)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.diamond_denominators
lean.code:
theorem diamond_denominators {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ Complex.diamond (1 - ε)) :
    0 < 1 - z.re - z.im ∧ 0 < 1 + z.re - z.im ∧
      0 < 1 + z.re + z.im ∧ 0 < 1 - z.re + z.im ∧
      0 < 1 + z.re ∧ 0 < 1 - z.re ∧ 0 < 1 + z.im ∧ 0 < 1 - z.im := by
  change |z.re| + |z.im| ≤ 1 - ε at hz
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    linarith [le_abs_self z.re, neg_abs_le z.re, le_abs_self z.im, neg_abs_le z.im,
      abs_nonneg z.re, abs_nonneg z.im]

On $D_{1-\epsilon}$, all four corner denominators
$1\pm x\pm y$ and all four side denominators $1\pm x,1\pm y$ are positive.
The rational field is therefore continuous there. Choose the inset from

blocks.label: st:field-group-sites
blocks.title: Grouping labelled square sites preserves the field
blocks.body:
Let $S_0,\ldots,S_7$ be the four square corners followed by the top, left,
bottom, and right contacts. For a finite label set $I$, a site assignment
$\tau:I\to\{0,\ldots,7\}$, and coefficients $c_i$, define
$g_j=\sum_{\tau(i)=j}c_i$. Then
\[
 \sum_{i\in I}\frac{c_i S_{\tau(i)}}{1-\langle a,S_{\tau(i)}\rangle}
 =\sum_{j=0}^7\frac{g_j S_j}{1-\langle a,S_j\rangle}.
\]
The right-hand side is the square field with magnitudes
$(g_0,-g_1,g_2,-g_3)$ and side coefficients $(g_4,g_5,g_6,g_7)$.
Every site denominator is positive on $D_{1-\epsilon}$ for $\epsilon>0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.weightsOfSites
lean.code:
def weightsOfSites (g : Fin 8 → ℝ) : SquareWeights :=
  ⟨g 0, -g 1, g 2, -g 3, g 4, g 5, g 6, g 7⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.field_squareSite
lean.code:
lemma field_squareSite (g : Fin 8 → ℝ) (a : ℂ) :
    ProjectiveBall.field g squareSite a = (weightsOfSites g).field a := by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [ProjectiveBall.field, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im]
  all_goals simp [squareSite, ProjectiveBall.denominator, Complex.inner,
    SquareWeights.field, upperProjection, weightsOfSites]
  all_goals ring

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareSite_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma squareSite_denominator_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {a : ℂ}
    (ha : a ∈ Complex.diamond (1 - ε)) (k : Fin 8) :
    0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (squareSite k) := by
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇⟩ := diamond_denominators hε ha
  fin_cases k <;> simp [squareSite, ProjectiveBall.denominator, Complex.inner]
  all_goals linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.siteCoefficient
lean.code:
noncomputable def siteCoefficient (c : ι → ℝ) (tag : ι → Fin 8) (k : Fin 8) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i with tag i = k, c i

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.field_group_sites
lean.code:
lemma field_group_sites (c : ι → ℝ) (tag : ι → Fin 8) (a : ℂ) :
    ProjectiveBall.field c (fun i ↦ squareSite (tag i)) a =
      ProjectiveBall.field (siteCoefficient c tag) squareSite a := by
  unfold ProjectiveBall.field siteCoefficient
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ tag]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2]

blocks.tex:
Partition the finite sum by the fibers of $\tau$; the vertex and denominator
are constant on each fiber. Evaluating the eight sites gives exactly the
six-term horizontal expression and its vertical counterpart. Positivity is
the eight-denominator estimate already established for the diamond.
This grouping is only an identity for the collapsed configuration: it does
not delete labels from the finite polygon constructed below.

blocks.label: st:field-vertex-zero
blocks.title: Nearby vertex lists retain a zero
blocks.body:
Fix a finite coefficient list $c$ and a vertex list $X$. Suppose $r>0$,
$1-\langle a,X_i\rangle>0$ for every $a\in D_r$ and every $i$, and the field
\[
 G_X(a)=\sum_i\frac{c_iX_i}{1-\langle a,X_i\rangle}
\]
has the four diamond signs. Every sufficiently nearby labelled vertex list
$Y$ has positive denominators on the entire same diamond and admits
$a\in D_r$ with $G_Y(a)=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuousAt_projectiveField
lean.code:
lemma continuousAt_projectiveField (c : ι → ℝ) {x : ι → ℂ} {a : ℂ}
    (hden : ∀ i, ProjectiveBall.denominator a (x i) ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : (ι → ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ProjectiveBall.field c p.1 p.2) (x, a) := by
  unfold ProjectiveBall.field
  apply tendsto_finsetSum
  intro i _
  have hx : Continuous (fun p : (ι → ℂ) × ℂ ↦ p.1 i) :=
    (continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst
  have hd : Continuous (fun p : (ι → ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ProjectiveBall.denominator p.2 (p.1 i)) :=
    continuous_const.sub (continuous_snd.inner hx)
  exact (continuousAt_const.div hd.continuousAt (hden i)).smul hx.continuousAt

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eventually_exists_projectiveField_zero
lean.code:
theorem eventually_exists_projectiveField_zero (c : ι → ℝ) {x : ι → ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hden : ∀ a ∈ Complex.diamond r, ∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (x i))
    (hs : Complex.DiamondSigns (ProjectiveBall.field c x) r) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ a ∈ Complex.diamond r,
      (∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (y i)) ∧ ProjectiveBall.field c y a = 0 := by
  have hsigns := Complex.eventually_diamondSigns
    (fun a ha ↦ continuousAt_projectiveField c (fun i ↦ (hden a ha i).ne')) hs
  filter_upwards [hsigns, eventually_projective_denominators_pos hden] with y hsy hdy
  have hc : ContinuousOn (ProjectiveBall.field c y) (Complex.diamond r) := by
    apply continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt
    intro a ha
    exact (continuousAt_projectiveField c (fun i ↦ (hdy a ha i).ne')).comp
      (continuousAt_const.prodMk continuousAt_id)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hzero⟩ := Complex.exists_zero_of_diamondSigns hr
    (ProjectiveBall.field c y) hc hsy
  exact ⟨a, ha, hdy a ha, hzero⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eventually_projective_denominators_pos
lean.code:
lemma eventually_projective_denominators_pos {x : ι → ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hden : ∀ a ∈ Complex.diamond r, ∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (x i)) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ a ∈ Complex.diamond r, ∀ i,
      0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (y i) := by
  apply (Complex.isCompact_diamond r).eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro a ha
  apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
  intro i
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : (ι → ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ProjectiveBall.denominator p.2 (p.1 i)) :=
    continuous_const.sub (continuous_snd.inner ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst))
  exact hc.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds (hden a ha i))

blocks.tex:
The finite rational sum is jointly continuous in $(X,a)$ wherever all
its denominators are nonzero. Each strictly positive denominator persists
uniformly over the compact diamond and the finite index set. The four
strict signs persist by the compact-slice lemma. For a nearby list the field
is continuous throughout the diamond, so the same zero theorem applies.
This proves existence for each nearby list, not continuity of a chosen zero.

blocks.label: st:field-perturbation
blocks.title: Projective balance persists under finite vertex perturbations
blocks.body:
Under the preceding hypotheses, also suppose $r<1$ and $\sum_i c_i=0$.
Every sufficiently nearby list $Y$ admits parameters $a,\sigma$ with
\[
 \|a\|<1,\quad \sigma>0,\quad \sigma^2+\|a\|^2=1,
 \quad 1-\langle a,Y_i\rangle>0\quad\hbox{for every }i,
\]
and exact balance $\sum_i c_i B_{a,\sigma}(Y_i)=0$ for the projective
map of \cref{st:projective-map}.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eventually_exists_projective_balance
lean.code:
theorem eventually_exists_projective_balance (c : ι → ℝ) {x : ι → ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hr₁ : r < 1) (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (hden : ∀ a ∈ Complex.diamond r, ∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (x i))
    (hs : Complex.DiamondSigns (ProjectiveBall.field c x) r) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ σ : ℝ, ‖a‖ < 1 ∧ 0 < σ ∧ σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (y i)) ∧
      ∑ i, c i • ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (y i) = 0 := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_exists_projectiveField_zero c hr hden hs] with y hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hda, hzero⟩ := hy
  have hanorm : ‖a‖ < 1 := ((Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im a).trans ha).trans_lt hr₁
  have hrad : 0 < 1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg a]
  refine ⟨a, Real.sqrt (1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2), hanorm, Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hrad,
    by rw [Real.sq_sqrt hrad.le]; ring, hda, ?_⟩
  exact ProjectiveBall.sum_smul_transform_eq_zero_of_field_eq_zero c y a _
    (fun i ↦ (hda i).ne') hsum hzero

blocks.tex:
Choose the field zero in $D_r$. The Euclidean norm is at most the coordinate
one-norm, hence $\|a\|\le r<1$. Set
$\sigma=\sqrt{1-\|a\|^2}>0$. The projective balance identity turns
$G_Y(a)=0$, together with $\sum_i c_i=0$, into the required weighted sum.
The nearby lists retain the same original coefficients exactly.

blocks.label: st:field-near-square
blocks.title: Balance near the labelled square
blocks.body:
Suppose $\sum_i c_i=0$, and the four grouped corner coefficients satisfy
$g_0>0,g_1<0,g_2>0,g_3<0$. Every labelled vertex list sufficiently close
to $(S_{\tau(i)})_{i\in I}$ has a projective normalization with positive
denominators and exact balance of the unchanged coefficients.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eventually_balance_near_square
lean.code:
theorem eventually_balance_near_square (c : ι → ℝ) (tag : ι → Fin 8)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < siteCoefficient c tag 0) (h₁ : siteCoefficient c tag 1 < 0)
    (h₂ : 0 < siteCoefficient c tag 2) (h₃ : siteCoefficient c tag 3 < 0) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (fun i ↦ squareSite (tag i)),
      ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ σ : ℝ, ‖a‖ < 1 ∧ 0 < σ ∧ σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1 ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (y i)) ∧
        ∑ i, c i • ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (y i) = 0 := by
  have hw : (weightsOfSites (siteCoefficient c tag)).Positive :=
    ⟨h₀, neg_pos.mpr h₁, h₂, neg_pos.mpr h₃⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε₁, hm⟩ := SquareWeights.exists_margins hw
  apply eventually_exists_projective_balance c (sub_pos.mpr hε₁)
    (by linarith : 1 - ε < 1) hsum
  · exact fun a ha i ↦ squareSite_denominator_pos hε ha (tag i)
  · have he : ProjectiveBall.field c (fun i ↦ squareSite (tag i)) =
        (weightsOfSites (siteCoefficient c tag)).field := by
      funext a
      rw [field_group_sites, field_squareSite]
    rw [he]
    exact SquareWeights.diamondSigns hw hε hm

Group the limiting field by sites. The four corner signs give positive

blocks.label: st:field-fan-angles
blocks.title: Opening the repeated square normals
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge4$ and $0<p<q<r<n$. Define the normal level $s_k$ to be $0$ at
$k=0$, $1$ for $1\le k\le p$, $2$ for $p<k\le q$, $3$ for $q<k\le r$,
and $4$ for $k>r$. Set
\[
 \theta_k(\eta)=(1-\eta)s_k\frac\pi2+
                    \eta\frac{2\pi k}{n}.
\]
For $0<\eta\le1$, these angles strictly increase, start at zero, and
satisfy $\theta_n(\eta)=2\pi$. Every successive gap is strictly less than
$\pi$ (indeed at most $\pi/2$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle_zero
lean.code:
lemma fanAngle_zero (n p q r : ℕ) (η : ℝ) : fanAngle n p q r η 0 = 0 := by
  simp [fanAngle, squareLevel]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle_strictMono
lean.code:
lemma fanAngle_strictMono {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) : StrictMono (fanAngle n p q r η) := by
  intro i j hij
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hij' : (i : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hij
  have hl : (squareLevel p q r i : ℝ) ≤ squareLevel p q r j := by
    exact_mod_cast squareLevel_monotone p q r hij.le
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (sub_nonneg.mpr hη₁)) (by positivity : 0 ≤ Real.pi / 2)
  have hg := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (div_lt_div_of_pos_right
    (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hij' (by positivity : 0 < 2 * Real.pi)) hn') hη
  exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hb hg

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle_end
lean.code:
lemma fanAngle_end {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hr : r < n) (hpq : p < q)
    (hqr : q < r) (η : ℝ) : fanAngle n p q r η n = 2 * Real.pi := by
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  simp [fanAngle, squareLevel, hn.ne', show ¬n ≤ p by omega,
    show ¬n ≤ q by omega, show ¬n ≤ r by omega, hn']
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanAngle_step_lt_pi
lean.code:
lemma fanAngle_step_lt_pi {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1) - fanAngle n p q r η k < Real.pi := by
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by omega)
  have hn₄ : (4 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hl : (squareLevel p q r (k + 1) : ℝ) - squareLevel p q r k ≤ 1 := by
    have h := squareLevel_step_le hp hpq hqr k
    exact_mod_cast (show (squareLevel p q r (k + 1) : ℤ) - squareLevel p q r k ≤ 1 by omega)
  have hb : ((squareLevel p q r (k + 1) : ℝ) - squareLevel p q r k) *
      (Real.pi / 2) ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hg : 2 * Real.pi / n ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hn').mpr
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have he : fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1) - fanAngle n p q r η k =
      (1 - η) * (((squareLevel p q r (k + 1) : ℝ) - squareLevel p q r k) *
        (Real.pi / 2)) + η * (2 * Real.pi / n) := by
    simp only [fanAngle, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hbound := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hη₁))
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg hη)
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]

noncomputable def fanAngle (n p q r : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - η) * (squareLevel p q r k : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2) +
    η * (2 * Real.pi * k / n)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareLevel_monotone

lemma squareLevel_monotone (p q r : ℕ) : Monotone (squareLevel p q r) := by
  intro i j hij
  unfold squareLevel
  split_ifs <;> omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareLevel
lean.code:
def squareLevel (p q r k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if k = 0 then 0 else if k ≤ p then 1 else if k ≤ q then 2 else if k ≤ r then 3 else 4

lemma squareLevel_step_le {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r)
    (k : ℕ) : squareLevel p q r (k + 1) ≤ squareLevel p q r k + 1 := by
  unfold squareLevel
  split_ifs <;> omega

blocks.tex:
The level sequence is nondecreasing and each level increment is at most
one. The regular-angle summand strictly increases when $\eta>0$.
Each blended gap is at most
$(1-\eta)\pi/2+\eta(2\pi/n)\le\pi/2<\pi$.
At the two endpoints the normal levels are $0$ and $4$, respectively,
so the displayed endpoint identities are exact.

blocks.title: The finite fan retains every label in the square limit
blocks.body:
Write $u(\theta)=e^{i\theta}$ and form consecutive tangent intersections
\[
 X_k(\eta)=\frac{u(\theta_k(\eta))+u(\theta_{k+1}(\eta))}
 {1+\langle u(\theta_k(\eta)),u(\theta_{k+1}(\eta))\rangle}.
\]
As $\eta\to0$, the labels $0,p,q,r$ approach the four square corners,
respectively. The labels strictly between them approach the top, left,
bottom, and right contacts, respectively. Each corner fiber consists of
exactly its selected label, so its grouped coefficient is precisely that
original coefficient. Every coordinate $X_k(\eta)$ is continuous at zero.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex_zero
lean.code:
lemma fanVertex_zero {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r)
    (n k : ℕ) : fanVertex n p q r 0 k = squareSite (squareTag p q r k) := by
  have he := squareLevel_pair hp hpq hqr k
  have he₁ : squareLevel p q r k = ![0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 4] (squareTag p q r k) :=
    congrArg Prod.fst he
  have he₂ : squareLevel p q r (k + 1) = ![1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4] (squareTag p q r k) :=
    congrArg Prod.snd he
  simp only [fanVertex, fanAngle, sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, he₁, he₂]
  convert tangentIntersection_quarter_pair (squareTag p q r k) using 1
  generalize squareTag p q r k = t
  fin_cases t <;> norm_num

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareLevel_pair
lean.code:
lemma squareLevel_pair {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (squareLevel p q r k, squareLevel p q r (k + 1)) =
      (![0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 4] (squareTag p q r k),
        ![1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4] (squareTag p q r k)) := by
  unfold squareTag
  split_ifs <;> norm_num only [squareLevel, Matrix.cons_val, Prod.mk.injEq] <;>
    (try split_ifs) <;> norm_num <;> omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.squareTag_corners
lean.code:
lemma squareTag_corners {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (squareTag p q r k = 0 ↔ k = 0) ∧ (squareTag p q r k = 1 ↔ k = p) ∧
      (squareTag p q r k = 2 ↔ k = q) ∧ (squareTag p q r k = 3 ↔ k = r) := by
  unfold squareTag
  split_ifs <;> norm_num <;> omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex
lean.code:
noncomputable def fanVertex (n p q r : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  tangentIntersection (normal (fanAngle n p q r η k))
    (normal (fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_quarter_pair
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_quarter_pair (k : Fin 8) :
    tangentIntersection (normal ((![0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 4] k : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2)))
      (normal ((![1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4] k : ℝ) * (Real.pi / 2))) = squareSite k := by
  fin_cases k <;> apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [tangentIntersection, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im]
  all_goals norm_num [squareSite, Complex.inner, show 3 * (Real.pi / 2) =
    Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 by ring, show 2 * (Real.pi / 2) = Real.pi by ring,
    show 4 * (Real.pi / 2) = 2 * Real.pi by ring, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add]

lemma siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℝ)
    (tag : ι → Fin 8) (k : Fin 8) (i : ι) (hi : ∀ j, tag j = k ↔ j = i) :
    siteCoefficient c tag k = c i := by
  classical
  simp only [siteCoefficient, hi, Finset.sum_filter]
  simp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuousAt_fanVertex_zero
lean.code:
lemma continuousAt_fanVertex_zero {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (k : ℕ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun η ↦ fanVertex n p q r η k) 0 := by
  have hg := fanAngle_step_lt_pi hn hp hpq hqr (η := 0) le_rfl zero_le_one k
  have ho : fanAngle n p q r 0 k ≤ fanAngle n p q r 0 (k + 1) := by
    simp only [fanAngle, sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
    have hl : (squareLevel p q r k : ℝ) ≤ squareLevel p q r (k + 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast squareLevel_monotone p q r (Nat.le_add_right k 1)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl (by positivity)
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun η : ℝ ↦
      (normal (fanAngle n p q r η k), normal (fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1)))) 0 :=
    ((continuous_normal.comp (continuous_fanAngle n p q r k)).prodMk
      (continuous_normal.comp (continuous_fanAngle n p q r (k + 1)))).continuousAt
  exact ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun η : ℝ ↦
    (normal (fanAngle n p q r η k), normal (fanAngle n p q r η (k + 1)))) (x := 0)
    (continuousAt_tangentIntersection (normal_denominator_pos ho hg).ne') hc

At zero the adjacent level pairs at the four selected labels are
$(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4)$, while the other pairs are
$(1,1),(2,2),(3,3),(4,4)$. Evaluate the tangent-intersection formula at these
quarter-turn normals: distinct consecutive normals give square corners,
and equal normals give their common unit contact. This defines the site
assignment without removing any label. Its corner fibers are singletons by
the strict index order, so summing over them leaves the original coefficient.
The angles are affine in $\eta$ and their zero-parameter gaps are at most
$\pi/2$, making the intersection denominator positive. Continuity of the
formula proves the simultaneous finite-list limit.

blocks.title: Strict support for a positive finite fan
blocks.body:
For $0<\eta\le1$, every $X_k(\eta)$ lies strictly in the inner half-plane
of each nonincident tangent line:
\[
 \langle u(\theta_j(\eta)),X_k(\eta)\rangle<1
 \qquad(j\ne k,\ j\ne k+1\pmod n).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex_strict_support
lean.code:
lemma fanVertex_strict_support {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1)
    (i j : Fin n) (hji : j ≠ i) (hnext : j ≠ i + 1) :
    ⟪normal (fanAngle n p q r η j), fanVertex n p q r η i⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have hn₀ : 0 < n := by omega
  have h_one : (1 : Fin n).val = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < n)]
  have hm := fanAngle_strictMono (p := p) (q := q) (r := r) hn₀ hη hη₁
  have hg := fanAngle_step_lt_pi hn hp hpq hqr hη.le hη₁ i
  have hend := fanAngle_end hn₀ hr hpq hqr η
  have hij : (j : ℕ) ≠ i := by exact fun he ↦ hji (Fin.ext he)
  have hijnext : (j : ℕ) ≠ (i : ℕ) + 1 := by
    intro he
    apply hnext
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n)]
    exact he
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · apply normal_support_lt_of_wrapped (hm hlt) (hm (Nat.lt_succ_self _)) hg
    have hib : fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      rw [← hend]
      exact hm.monotone (by omega)
    by_cases hj₀ : (j : ℕ) = 0
    · have hil : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n := by
        by_contra h
        apply hnext
        apply Fin.ext
        rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, show (i : ℕ) + 1 = n by omega, Nat.mod_self]
        exact hj₀
      have hiθ := hm hil
      simpa only [hj₀, fanAngle_zero, zero_add, hend] using hiθ
    · have hjθ := hm (show 0 < (j : ℕ) by omega)
      rw [fanAngle_zero] at hjθ
      linarith
  · apply normal_support_lt_of_ordered (hm (Nat.lt_succ_self _)) hg (hm (by omega))
    have hjθ := hm j.isLt
    have hiθ := hm.monotone (Nat.zero_le (i : ℕ))
    rw [hend] at hjθ
    rw [fanAngle_zero] at hiθ
    linarith

For a label outside the adjacent pair, its lifted angle either precedes
both endpoint angles or follows both. Strict order and gaps below $\pi$
place it outside the short normal arc determining this tangent intersection;
the tangent support inequality is then strict. At the cyclic seam,
$\theta_n=2\pi$ identifies the ending normal with the starting one, and the
wrapped version of the same inequality applies. Thus the support conclusion
holds for every label, not only for the four selected corners.

blocks.label: st:field-balance
blocks.title: A balanced finite tangential fan
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge4$, $0<p<q<r<n$, and let $(c_k)_{k=0}^{n-1}$ satisfy
\[
 \sum_k c_k=0,\qquad c_0>0,\quad c_p<0,\quad c_q>0,\quad c_r<0.
\]
There exist $0<\eta<1$, $\|a\|<1$, and $\sigma>0$ with
$\sigma^2+\|a\|^2=1$, all denominators
$1-\langle a,X_k(\eta)\rangle$ positive, and
\[
 \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} c_k B_{a,\sigma}(X_k(\eta))=0.
\]
No condition is imposed on the signs or vanishing of unselected coefficients.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_balanced_squareFan
lean.code:
theorem exists_balanced_squareFan {n p q r : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < c ⟨0, by omega⟩) (h₁ : c ⟨p, by omega⟩ < 0)
    (h₂ : 0 < c ⟨q, by omega⟩) (h₃ : c ⟨r, hr⟩ < 0) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ a : ℂ, ∃ σ : ℝ,
      ‖a‖ < 1 ∧ 0 < σ ∧ σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1 ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (fanVertex n p q r η i)) ∧
        ∑ i : Fin n, c i • ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i) = 0 := by
  let tag : Fin n → Fin 8 := fun i ↦ squareTag p q r i
  have ht₀ : siteCoefficient c tag 0 = c ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
    apply siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
    intro i
    simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using (squareTag_corners hp hpq hqr i).1
  have ht₁ : siteCoefficient c tag 1 = c ⟨p, by omega⟩ := by
    apply siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
    intro i
    simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using (squareTag_corners hp hpq hqr i).2.1
  have ht₂ : siteCoefficient c tag 2 = c ⟨q, by omega⟩ := by
    apply siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
    intro i
    simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using (squareTag_corners hp hpq hqr i).2.2.1
  have ht₃ : siteCoefficient c tag 3 = c ⟨r, hr⟩ := by
    apply siteCoefficient_eq_of_fiber
    intro i
    simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using (squareTag_corners hp hpq hqr i).2.2.2
  have hb := eventually_balance_near_square c tag hsum
    (ht₀.symm ▸ h₀) (ht₁.symm ▸ h₁) (ht₂.symm ▸ h₂) (ht₃.symm ▸ h₃)
  have hc : Tendsto (fun η : ℝ ↦ fun i : Fin n ↦ fanVertex n p q r η i)
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (fun i ↦ squareSite (tag i))) := by
    apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
    intro i
    have hi := continuousAt_fanVertex_zero hn hp hpq hqr i
    rw [ContinuousAt, fanVertex_zero hp hpq hqr] at hi
    exact hi
  have hbη := (hc.eventually hb).filter_mono
    (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
  have hη₀ : ∀ᶠ η : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, 0 < η := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  have hη₁ : ∀ᶠ η : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, η < 1 :=
    Filter.Eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      (Iio_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
  obtain ⟨η, hη₀, hη₁, hbalance⟩ := (hη₀.and (hη₁.and hbη)).exists
  exact ⟨η, hη₀, hη₁, hbalance⟩

The square-limit site assignment has singleton corner fibers, so the four
selected signs are exactly the grouped corner signs needed in
\cref{st:field-near-square}. The full labelled list $X(\eta)$ tends to this
configuration as $\eta\to0$. Therefore every sufficiently small positive
$\eta$ lies in its balance neighborhood. Choose one such finite parameter
with $\eta<1$ and take the associated projective parameters. Positive $\eta$
ensures strict cyclic normal order and strict support; its exact balance
retains every original label and coefficient. The projective geometry chapter
then verifies that this normalization is an actual strict tangential polygon.
